lemmas.primary_translation: to treat someone with caution to avoid conflict or dissatisfaction

definitions.text: behandle noen med forsiktighet for å unngå konflikt eller misnøye
definitions.translation: to treat someone with caution to avoid conflict or dissatisfaction (lit. stroke someone with the grain)

examples.no: han smisker aldri og stryker ingen medhårs
examples.en: he never flatters anyone or tries to placate them
